assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Official precise site redline (boundary) has not been released by the organizer; the submitted boundary is a provisional substitute inferred from public materials.
assumptions.impact: All area figures (site, key areas, green, public, building footprint) are recomputed from the provisional geometry and must not be used as a redline or approval basis.
assumptions.recovery_condition: Recompute all area metrics and key-area areas from the official redline once published, and regenerate a variance report.

assumptions.statement: Statutory planning indicators (FAR, building height, green-ratio control) are unknown in the public site package; the values in this submission are conceptual suggestions.
assumptions.impact: Concept FAR / height / density cannot be presented as approved control conditions.
assumptions.recovery_condition: Replace conceptual indicators with official approved planning limits from the controlling regulatory plan.

assumptions.statement: Existing building conditions are not available from official survey; buildings in this submission are agent-generated design massing (agent_generated_design), not measured existing stock.
assumptions.impact: Building footprint area and retain/renovate/demolish classification are conceptual, not a survey base for engineering.
assumptions.recovery_condition: Re-derive building stock and the retain/renovate/demolish split from official measured building data before statutory use.

assumptions.statement: Population and talent base for the site and its catchment are not provided; talent personas and community-scale estimates are conceptual.
assumptions.impact: AI-talent ecosystem sizing and community service capacity are indicative only.
assumptions.recovery_condition: Calibrate personas and service capacity against official population / talent statistics when released.

assumptions.statement: Underground space and municipal infrastructure capacity (water, energy, drainage, telecom) are not in the public site package; related strategies are conceptual.
assumptions.impact: Municipal and underground-space measures are not yet engineering-validated.
assumptions.recovery_condition: Validate underground and municipal strategies against official utility and geotechnical data before implementation.
